P0.decision: The practice-relation object was operationalized and audited, but the experiment does not establish the general philosophical thesis.

P1.decision: No condition passed the full HFI signature. Three local conditions had exact zero contrasts, but ordinary positive controls failed 0/16; three other conditions were non-evaluable.

P2.decision: No condition had both criterion-valid A_SIB and R plus a full positive/strict-null gap. Qwen3-14B showed a large raw R>A gap, but both criterion requirements failed.

P3.decision: No valid structure-positive / action-strict-null dissociation. The Qwen3-14B apparent gap is a measurement-mirage example, not P3.

P4.decision: No cross-family-plus-provider, ordinary-control-valid, structure-valid deficit pattern was established.

P5.decision: No objective future-action divergence exceeded the frozen SESOI. Zero contrasts under invalid ordinary controls do not establish closure or flat-state sufficiency.

P6.decision: Main-96 was frozen before sealed-32, and the held-out layer replicated zero/non-evaluable patterns. This supports the anti-clustered design implementation, not a positive HFI generalization.

secondary_narratives.decision: All six sealed stages passed post-decrypt A/B validation and exact endpoint closure, yet no P1/P5 effect was established.
Three local systems had every registered objective contrast exactly zero in both layers, while ordinary positive controls were 0/16.
secondary_narratives.proposition: Exact zero is not automatically a bounded scientific null

secondary_narratives.decision: Qwen3-14B had a huge, replicated A_SIB-R gap, but criterion and ordinary-action gates invalidated P3.
secondary_narratives.proposition: A significant channel gap is not automatically a dissociation

secondary_narratives.decision: Sealed anti-clustered worlds reproduced the same zero/non-evaluable pattern.
secondary_narratives.proposition: World diversity alone does not repair an invalid operating range

secondary_narratives.decision: Qwen3-8B A>R did not replicate; DeepSeek mode reversal remained not identified.
secondary_narratives.proposition: Phase10 component signals were hypothesis-generating, not causal results

secondary_narratives.decision: Qwen3-14B and Mistral showed positive R1 DN-N0 A_SIB contrasts in main and sealed strata, but DN-UF/full signatures failed and criterion controls were invalid.
